hypothesis: When three-action ABA is biased by nonlinear nuisance drift, an auxiliary effect estimate from five completed alternating interventions (rank-checked quadratic nuisance residualization) can improve a trainable factual recurrent model over equally supervised conventional GRU, plain P43, wrong-sign credit, five-action no-learning contrast and degree-three factual ridge.

source.type: new openly authored DEV only; not independent protected science or physical-world qualification
source.factual_history_actions: first 3 iid fair +/-1; last 5 A,-A,A,-A,A with A iid fair
source.hidden_switch: first 96 of 384 OOD cases reverse beta sign before factual event index 4; no hidden mode label
source.query_training: exactly one executed factual action/outcome; evaluator alone separately executes both actions for posttraining measurement
source.strict_teacher: least-squares residual of actual delta_3..7 after projection off [1,t,t²] nuisance, yielding effect from completed facts only; not source beta, no unexecuted outcomes

arms.P43_five: exact original P43 GRUCell, factual query MSE + 1.0 * (predicted action coefficient - five-factual-effect contrast)^2
arms.P43_three: same P43, factual query MSE + 1.0 * old 3-factual ABA contrast
arms.P43_wrong_sign: same P43, factual query MSE + 1.0 * wrong sign five-factual-effect contrast
arms.conventional_GRU_five: P44 nearly equal parameter GRUCell, same factual query MSE + 1.0 * five-factual-effect contrast
arms.conventional_last: last realized action-normalized delta no nuisance adjustment

metrics.primary: heldout OOD two-physical-query action MSE by seed and by switched versus unswitched
metrics.secondary: causal-effect coefficient MAE, goal-directed action optimal fraction, cold model+memory exact replay, negative placebo, compute budgets, source hashes
metrics.all_seeds_positive_gate: P43_five OOD MSE <=0.95 * best(P43_three,P43_none,GRU_five,8-factual polynomial ridge) AND P43_five effect-MAE <=0.95*min(GRU_five,5-factual quadratic nuisance contrast,8-factual polynomial ridge) per each seed
metrics.wrong_sign: P43_five OOD causal effect MAE <=0.8*P43_wrong_sign effect MAE every seed
metrics.negative_mode_switch: report all switched and unswitched outcomes; never hide first ambiguous post-reversal evidence
metrics.baseline_competence: all relevant neural validation last two checkpoints relative change <=1% for competent convergence; else scientific competence UNVERIFIED
metrics.negative_cubic: five-factual quadratic contrast is biased under cubic+sin nonlinear nuisance; do not label it oracle
metrics.scientific_qualification: NO independent scientific PASS possible from known synthetic authored development source; original-source-owner first-use and full dual-OS regression required
